Visit note | 2026-03-09 12:30 PM | Dr. Farhana Kabir, General Medicine | Patient: Sohel Dewan, 27, male. Mr. Dewan presents stating he has pain behind his eyes, severe aching in his bones and muscles, and a faint rash on his arms. He has no comorbid medical conditions and denies chest pain or breathing difficulty.
